info.title: codemetrics - complexity metrics for C# code
info.description: CodeMetrics.Cli measures cyclomatic and cognitive complexity for C# source files with a fast syntax-only Roslyn workflow.

options.name: --output
options.description:
Write to a file instead of stdout.
With -s, relocates the file copy.

options.name: --max-cyclomatic
options.description: Exit 1 if any member exceeds this.

options.name: --max-cognitive
options.description: Exit 1 if any member exceeds this.

options.name: --single
options.description:
Single-file mode: report to stdout
plus a copy next to the file.

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help.
Exit codes:
0  clean
1  a threshold was exceeded
2  bad arguments or nothing to analyse
